$comment: Design-token record for Jade & Ember (ledger ENG-002, ENG-018). The values are a SNAPSHOT of the frozen v0.8 :root block in styles.css, taken so that tokens are checked as engineering structure: defined once, referenced, valid, paired for contrast, and unchanged unless the owner approves a visual change. This file carries no aesthetic rules and does not choose values: Anthropic Frontend Design decides the palette, type and spacing (docs/JADE_AND_EMBER_FRAMEWORK_REFERENCE.md). Changing a value is a visual change and needs a recorded owner approval before this file and styles.css are edited together. Firelight update (APR-JE-052): the colour, gutter and header values were changed together with styles.css on the isolated Firelight branch; the v0.9 branch keeps the v0.8 values.
